miller_record.name: Miller's Ledger
miller_record.greeting: The measure is hollow under its mark. The short weight has been feeding the same households for years.
lines: Kael: The ledger counts ash as fertilizer. The wagon totals match the refugee register.
Mira: Closing the mill stops the tainted channels. It also stops the flour coming through them.
Kael: The record leaves with us whatever we do to the machinery.
Mira: Good. Now decide how we feed the people who did not choose what was ground here.

actions.label: Close the tainted channels. Preserve the ledger and ration reserves.
actions.result: The ledger is kept. The mill closes while relief grain is divided; workers lose shifts and the village must carry sacks from the reserve.
actions.preview: The ledger is kept. The mill closes while relief grain is divided; workers lose shifts and the village must carry sacks from the reserve.
actions.cost: Closure uses reserves; supervision retains contamination risk; restitution takes clean materials and labor.

actions.label: Keep supervised milling. Replace the contaminated working copy.
actions.result: The ruined working sheet is burned after a signed copy is kept. Supervised milling supplies flour while separate clean channels are prepared.
actions.preview: The ruined working sheet is burned after a signed copy is kept. Supervised milling supplies flour while separate clean channels are prepared.
actions.cost: Closure uses reserves; supervision retains contamination risk; restitution takes clean materials and labor.

actions.label: Post the accounts. Begin clean repairs and pay for restitution.
actions.result: The accounts are copied publicly. Workers begin replacing the channels; the first clean flour goes to affected households.
actions.preview: The accounts are copied publicly. Workers begin replacing the channels; the first clean flour goes to affected households.
actions.cost: Closure uses reserves; supervision retains contamination risk; restitution takes clean materials and labor.

captain_senn.name: Captain Senn
captain_senn.greeting: Put the sword down far enough that my men can see what surrender looks like.
lines: Senn: I was on that road in the war. Young enough to call an order the whole explanation.
Senn: Halvern refused to close the retreat. They hanged him. I closed it after him.
Kael: Now you take grain from travelers and call it repayment.
Senn: I said their houses owed ours. It became an excuse before I stopped needing it.
Kael: You can give testimony. You still answer for the people hurt this week.

actions.label: Accept surrender under custody. Ask for freely given testimony.
actions.result: Senn lays down his sword and signs his own account. Custody remains; his oath to speak is voluntary.
actions.preview: Senn lays down his sword and signs his own account. Custody remains; his oath to speak is voluntary.
actions.cost: Custody needs protection; exile removes a living witness; execution destroys future testimony.

actions.label: Take the written account. Disarm the camp and permit exile.
actions.result: Senn leaves the confession and stolen supplies. He goes without offering a living oath.
actions.preview: Senn leaves the confession and stolen supplies. He goes without offering a living oath.
actions.cost: Custody needs protection; exile removes a living witness; execution destroys future testimony.

actions.label: Execute Senn for the road killings. Keep the documented account.
actions.result: Senn dies. The camp's signed account survives; no dead man is counted as a consenting living witness.
actions.preview: Senn dies. The camp's signed account survives; no dead man is counted as a consenting living witness.
actions.cost: Custody needs protection; exile removes a living witness; execution destroys future testimony.

actions.label: Find the soldiers who left your banner
Carry the deserters' signed refusal to Greyfen
actions.result: The deserters choose to sign what they saw. Their refusal corroborates the command; it does not absolve what they did before it.
actions.preview: The deserters choose to sign what they saw. Their refusal corroborates the command; it does not absolve what they did before it.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: Shield the deserters' names from Vargan
actions.result: The refusal is copied without homes or relatives. Senn's crimes remain public while his former soldiers receive a protected route.
actions.preview: The refusal is copied without homes or relatives. Senn's crimes remain public while his former soldiers receive a protected route.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

variants.greeting: My men have the custody terms. No levy can take their children for what I ordered.
lines: Senn: I will speak. I am not asking the account to wipe the road clean.
Kael: Then sign the part you know. Leave the rest for the people who lived it.

variants.greeting: The camp is packing. The signed account stays with you.
lines: Senn: My men leave their blades for the grain they took.
Kael: Leaving does not make the missing travelers someone else's problem.

halvern.name: Sir Halvern
halvern.greeting: Do not close it. There are still people on the road.
lines: Halvern: Sanctuary under the Vargan seal. Those were the words. They came because of the words.
Kael: What happened after you refused?
Halvern: Rope. The yard. Dawn. Do not close it.
Kael: You cannot tell me about Edric. Your memory ends here.
Kael: I was ordered to retreat from another road. There were people we had promised to escort. I went.
Kael: I wrote that we could not hold. I left out that I never went back.
Halvern: There are still people on the road.

actions.label: Preserve the refusal as testimony. Do not demand another oath.
actions.result: Kael copies the sanctuary order and refusal. The bounded memory stays with the blade; it cannot consent for a living person.
actions.preview: Kael copies the sanctuary order and refusal. The bounded memory stays with the blade; it cannot consent for a living person.
actions.cost: Copies preserve the refusal, not every memory the fragment carries.

actions.label: Record the refusal, then release the exhausted memory.
actions.result: The order and refusal are copied before the fragment settles. Kael keeps his own confession in the same account.
actions.preview: The order and refusal are copied before the fragment settles. Kael keeps his own confession in the same account.
actions.cost: Copies preserve the refusal, not every memory the fragment carries.

actions.label: Keep the copied order. End the remaining grave binding.
actions.result: The irreplaceable shape is destroyed after its command is recorded. The copied proof remains; its surrounding memories are lost.
actions.preview: The irreplaceable shape is destroyed after its command is recorded. The copied proof remains; its surrounding memories are lost.
actions.cost: Copies preserve the refusal, not every memory the fragment carries.

assembly_choice.name: Greyfen Assembly
assembly_choice.greeting: Edric's grain list lies beside the new seal. Some households have already signed because their sacks are empty.
lines: Anwen: The wax will not hold. They agreed to eat, Edric. They did not agree to carry the road.
Kael: I left civilians on a road after promising escort. I called it a retreat in my report. That part of my report was a lie.
Rook: Then do not ask us to sign yours because you finally stayed.
Kael: I will not. The copies establish what happened. Each of you decides whether to offer more.
Anwen: Break the grain condition before you touch the seal. Otherwise the rite only learns a new way to threaten us.

actions.label: Release the grain. Invite only those who choose to speak.
actions.result: The ration condition is struck out. Willing witnesses speak; anyone who refuses can receive food and leave. Kael keeps the remaining record.
actions.preview: The ration condition is struck out. Willing witnesses speak; anyone who refuses can receive food and leave. Kael keeps the remaining record.
actions.cost: The renewal must end without withholding food from anyone who refuses to speak.

actions.label: Break the ration condition. Carry the account yourself.
actions.result: Kael removes the renewal seal and reads the copied account. No household is pledged by being present. He accepts the work of preserving what he read.
actions.preview: Kael removes the renewal seal and reads the copied account. No household is pledged by being present. He accepts the work of preserving what he read.
actions.cost: The renewal must end without withholding food from anyone who refuses to speak.

actions.label: Break the condition and make Edric answer from the ledger.
actions.result: The coercive renewal is stopped. Edric's compelled admission is entered as evidence; it is not counted as consent to the replacement covenant.
actions.preview: The coercive renewal is stopped. Edric's compelled admission is entered as evidence; it is not counted as consent to the replacement covenant.
actions.cost: The renewal must end without withholding food from anyone who refuses to speak.

actions.label: Place the miller's measure before the assembly
actions.result: The true weight is entered beside the names of the missing.
actions.preview: The true weight is entered beside the names of the missing.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: Read the deserters' refusal into the record
actions.result: Greyfen hears the names even without Senn beside them.
actions.preview: Greyfen hears the names even without Senn beside them.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

variants.greeting: Edric removes his seal from the grain list in front of the waiting households.
lines: Edric: Every household receives its allotment. No signature. My account comes afterward.
Kael: I left people behind under a retreat order. I stayed away and called it duty. That is my account before I ask for yours.
Rook: Then give people time to decide. A hand raised in relief is not an oath.

witness_-7.name: Mira Fen
witness_-7.greeting: I grew the medicine in the ash bed. Families were not told.
lines: Mira: Some choose it now. Others choose the clean roots. I still treat them.
Mira: The cure was real. So was the choice I kept from them.

variants.greeting: The ash bed is closed. I will explain why the replacement takes longer.
lines: Mira: There will be shortages. I will not hide them behind a clean label.

witness_-3.name: Rook
witness_-3.greeting: I can tell you where the road ran. I have removed the family homes from the copy.
lines: Rook: My grandmother kept these names. She did not leave me permission to hand you every private part of her life.
Rook: The road is evidence. The addresses are not.

variants.greeting: You have the route. You do not have my promise to stand in a rite.
lines: Rook: A record is not a person agreeing. Keep that straight.

witness_3.name: Sister Anwen
witness_3.greeting: I resealed the book after the novice died. Every year afterward I called it care.
lines: Anwen: I was afraid. That explains what I did. It does not give the unnamed people back their years.
Anwen: My confession is my own. No household has to follow it to receive grain.

edric_campaign.name: Lord Edric Vargan
edric_campaign.greeting: The grain you saw outside is real. So is the road that killed the people sent to clear it.
lines: Edric: I found the command ledger six years ago. I sealed it. I was afraid of what the houses here would become without Vargan protection.
Kael: You inherited the crime. Keeping its proof hidden was your choice.
Edric: Yes. The renewal is my choice too. I need households to witness the seal before the grain moves.
Kael: People who must sign to feed their children cannot give you a free oath.
Edric: Then give me another way to get those carts through. Do not give me a principle and leave before winter.

actions.label: Protect his hearing, not his title. Ask him to stop the renewal.
actions.result: Edric voluntarily agrees to testify and release the grain without household signatures. His title and accounts pass to the public hearing.
actions.preview: Edric voluntarily agrees to testify and release the grain without household signatures. His title and accounts pass to the public hearing.
actions.cost: Protection cannot shelter Edric's title; compelled words establish facts without supplying consent.

actions.label: Make the ledger public. Remove his power to require signatures.
actions.result: The ledger is exposed and the seal challenged. Edric refuses a personal oath; the proof is sufficient without pretending he agrees.
actions.preview: The ledger is exposed and the seal challenged. Edric refuses a personal oath; the proof is sufficient without pretending he agrees.
actions.cost: Protection cannot shelter Edric's title; compelled words establish facts without supplying consent.

actions.label: Compel his admission. Use the ledger as evidence, not his oath.
actions.result: Edric admits his concealment under pressure. His words establish facts; the new covenant must use someone else's freely given responsibility.
actions.preview: Edric admits his concealment under pressure. His words establish facts; the new covenant must use someone else's freely given responsibility.
actions.cost: Protection cannot shelter Edric's title; compelled words establish facts without supplying consent.

variants.greeting: I have withdrawn the household signatures. My officers have the same order.
lines: Edric: I will testify without my seal. I will supply the road under the assembly's account.
Kael: Your title?
Edric: Not mine to shelter behind after this.

variants.greeting: I will say what you make me say. Do not dress it as consent.
lines: Kael: Your ledger is evidence. Your threatened words are not a new covenant.
Edric: At least we agree on the shape of what you are doing.

white_hart.name: The White Hart
white_hart.greeting: You have kept the account where a living hand can reach it. That is something the old oath would not allow.
lines: Kael: The grain condition is broken. No one standing here has to promise you anything to eat.
The White Hart: I remember the gate shut. I remember the road hidden. I remember the soldiers entering. I will not tell you those were one man's act.
Kael: The copies survive. I will freely keep what we have recovered. I cannot swear for the people who refused.
The White Hart: One willing keeper of an account is enough to begin. Others may share that work. None may be given it by force.
The White Hart: Make the account public and I will leave its judgment with you. Release me quietly and preserve the record without opening every private memory.
The White Hart: Or carry the unresolved binding yourself. Or destroy me and lose what no copy holds.
Kael: Releasing you does not erase the house's crime. Protecting a family does not protect Edric from the record.
The White Hart: Then choose whose work begins when mine ends.

actions.label: Witness — make the account public; stay to preserve it.
actions.preview: Release the Hart through public acknowledgment and Kael's willing work to preserve the record.
actions.cost: Lost privilege, trade pressure, and the ongoing labor of restitution. Fewer allies mean more work for Kael.

actions.label: Mercy — release the Hart; safeguard names and private memories.
actions.preview: Release the Hart while protecting private memories; institutional crimes remain on record.
actions.cost: A protected circle must preserve the truth; partial public acknowledgment leaves unresolved grievances.

actions.label: Duty — freely carry the unresolved binding myself.
actions.preview: Kael willingly carries the continuing binding. No other person is pledged.
actions.cost: Kael loses freedom and rest. The village gains time while the injustice remains unfinished.

actions.label: Ash — destroy the Hart; keep the human record and face the loss.
actions.preview: Destroy the complete witness by combat; the copied human record survives.
actions.cost: Irreplaceable memories are lost. Dispersal harms the land and future harvests.

witness_7.name: The Record
witness_7.greeting: Bram Kett. Sella Vey. Oren Vey. The older name beneath the painted crow.
lines: Kael: These pages establish what we recovered. They do not promise for the people who could not come.
Kael: Leave room for what the Hart knows that our copies do not.

side_contracts.name: Greyfen's Smaller Miseries
side_contracts.greeting: Elna has pinned a bell cord here. Tor has weighted a note with a bent hinge. Mira's paper smells of roots.
lines: Some ask for payment. Some ask that you knock quietly. Rook's note has a road drawn on the back.
Kael: People to return to. Not just work to finish.

actions.label: Visit Elna about Harl's bell.
Ask Tor about the marks in his iron.
Help Mira find another fever treatment.
Hear Toma's account of the sheepfold.
Follow the watch that left an empty grave.
Return Oren's thread to a named place.
Carry the Bannerless soldiers' refusal.
Recover the true weight of the ash.
Walk Rook's road against the waystone.
Light a candle for each missing traveler.

crow_shrine_choice.name: The Crow Shrine
crow_shrine_choice.greeting: The red thread pulls tight toward the sealed road. Anwen cuts her own prayer cord before touching it.
lines: Anwen: I used to say the shrine kept the dead quiet. It kept their names apart.
Kael: What does each way cost?
Anwen: Clean the rite and the danger moves out toward the wood. Open it and memory enters this place. Hold it shut and the next repair may tear it again.
Anwen: None of those asks the dead what they wanted. A living witness can freely take the work of keeping their account. Not the right to make them disappear.
crow_shrine_choice.voice_direction: Quiet and intimate; every option carries a cost.

actions.label: Clean the rite. Accept the danger shifting to the wood.
actions.result: The chapel quiets. Anwen records that the debt was redirected, not erased, and goes to name the graves.
actions.preview: The chapel quiets. Anwen records that the debt was redirected, not erased, and goes to name the graves.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: Open the memory. Keep the gathered names intact.
actions.result: The erased names surface at the shrine. The village hears the bell; the recovered fragments are kept intact.
actions.preview: The erased names surface at the shrine. The village hears the bell; the recovered fragments are kept intact.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: Hold the seal for now. Mark its limits in the record.
actions.result: The seal holds temporarily. Kael marks its weakness instead of calling the silence a cure.
actions.preview: The seal holds temporarily. Kael marks its weakness instead of calling the silence a cure.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

bog_core_choice.name: The Bog Wretch's Memory
bog_core_choice.greeting: The root knot tightens around a small painted crow. One frightened moment keeps moving through it.
lines: Mira: Oren said the name. Something opened. This is not him returned to answer us.
Kael: If we break it?
Mira: This vessel stops. Its memory disperses. If we keep it, we must stop treating every reaction as an invitation.
Kael: Or return the fragment where his name can hold it.
Mira: Yes. I can refine the oil whichever way you choose. I will not price a formula against a child's memory.

variants.greeting: The Moon Oil reveals a groove beneath the new paint. Oren had restored the first name on the old token.
lines: Mira: The creatures gathered what the road could no longer hide. The wire came later.
Kael: Vargan tried to contain the evidence.
Mira: Keep that fact. This fragment cannot tell us everything that happened.

actions.label: Destroy the memory core
actions.result: The vessel collapses; its memory disperses into the wet ground. Mira keeps ordinary medicine available and prepares the refined oil.
actions.preview: The vessel collapses; its memory disperses into the wet ground. Mira keeps ordinary medicine available and prepares the refined oil.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: Preserve it for study
actions.result: Mira wraps the fragment and limits her study to what is already exposed. The future treatment must respect family consent.
actions.preview: Mira wraps the fragment and limits her study to what is already exposed. The future treatment must respect family consent.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: Return it to Oren's grave
actions.result: The fragment is settled beneath Oren's named marker. Its dangerous shape ends without opening its intimate memory to the village.
actions.preview: The fragment is settled beneath Oren's named marker. Its dangerous shape ends without opening its intimate memory to the village.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

retain_evidence.name: Oren's Token
retain_evidence.greeting: A thumb-sized crow. Fresh paint above a name cut into older wood.
lines: Kael: Oren was making something someone had erased readable again.
Kael: Keeping this close gives me time. It also leaves everyone else waiting for an account.

village_stories.name: The Lives Beside the Road
village_stories.greeting: A bell on a windowsill. New nails beside an old hinge. Roots laid out beneath labeled jars.
lines: Kael: What matters is whether I returned after asking them to change.

names_decision.name: The Refugee Register
names_decision.greeting: Rook puts a clean sheet over the family addresses before he hands you the register.
lines: Rook: The people who died can be named. Where their grandchildren sleep is not the same fact.
Anwen: Bram found the tokens in the repaired road. Sella brought one for a burial reading. Oren restored the first name beneath his paint.
Kael: The name loosened what the hidden road had kept disordered.
Anwen: And my thread failed to contain it. Vargan's men came afterward for the tokens.
Rook: Now Edric wants those households at a renewal. No signature, no grain. Your copies will reach them before his guards do.

actions.label: Publish the recovered names and order. Remove family addresses.
actions.result: The dead are named publicly and Edric's order is challenged. Family addresses stay off the board; fear and solidarity both follow.
actions.preview: The dead are named publicly and Edric's order is challenged. Family addresses stay off the board; fear and solidarity both follow.
actions.cost: Delay leaves the renewal order unchallenged; publicity can endanger people who carry the account.

actions.label: Keep protected copies until the assembly. Tell each affected household.
actions.result: Anwen and Rook keep separate copies. Affected households are warned privately before the assembly; the delay leaves the public order unchallenged for now.
actions.preview: Anwen and Rook keep separate copies. Affected households are warned privately before the assembly; the delay leaves the public order unchallenged for now.
actions.cost: Delay leaves the renewal order unchallenged; publicity can endanger people who carry the account.

vargan_gate_guard.name: Vargan Gate Guard
vargan_gate_guard.greeting: Keep the lane clear. That cart is carrying grain, not reinforcements.
lines: Kael: I carry an account from Greyfen's road.
Guard: The steward wants every token brought inside. People argue less over a missing thing when no one can show it.
Kael: Then you had better let me show it.

variants.greeting: The steward says a seal was broken. I can see why he is frightened.
lines: Guard: You may still leave by the gate. The road must carry people as well as orders.

actions.label: I carry testimony from the old road.
actions.result: The guard steps aside without lowering his hand from the sword.
actions.preview: The guard steps aside without lowering his hand from the sword.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

vargan_steward.name: Steward Merrow
vargan_steward.greeting: The empty sacks go left. The petitions go right. Do not mix them.
lines: Kael: Why are household signatures beside grain allotments?
Merrow: A supported household witnesses the renewal. Those are the terms.
Kael: Terms offered to someone hungry do not make a free promise.

vargan_servant.name: Tired Castle Servant
vargan_servant.greeting: I set an extra place when the grain drivers are late. It does not get them here, but it keeps someone expecting them.
lines: The archive lamps answer names cut from the old books. Start with the marks along the shelf. Not every answer has a voice.

vargan_patrol.name: Vargan Patrol Guard
vargan_patrol.greeting: We were sent for the painted tokens after the creatures gathered. Two men did not come back.
lines: Kael: Did your orders include scratching out their names?
Guard: Contain the breach. Bring back every object. The paper did not say what to do when a child's name made the wire shake.

vargan_record_keeper.name: Record Keeper Vale
vargan_record_keeper.greeting: I have laid the uncut page under the lamp. You may read it. I have waited too long to say that.
lines: Vale: Sanctuary was promised under the Vargan seal. The closure order followed on the same day.
Kael: You kept both?
Vale: I kept them and let the steward keep people from reading them. I will sign that fact.

edric_castle.name: Lord Edric Vargan
edric_castle.greeting: Sit if your leg is hurting. Then tell me exactly what you found.
lines: Kael: Your soldiers reclaimed the tokens after the road repairs.
Edric: I ordered containment. The repairs had exposed a cache the shrine could no longer quiet.
Kael: You also kept the ledger closed for six years.
Edric: Yes. Before you ask the next question, know that I have no smaller word for that.

vargan_ledger_choice.name: The Sealed Command Ledger
vargan_ledger_choice.greeting: Sanctuary promised. Road closed. Refugee wagons transferred to shrine custody. Three columns written by three different hands.
lines: Kael: The command survived without the names. The register has the names without the command.
Kael: Together they establish who did what. Copy the page before any choice about its seal.

actions.label: Take the fragment openly
actions.result: Kael copies the command, then takes the original in sight of the keeper. The broken seal raises suspicion; the facts survive.
actions.preview: Kael copies the command, then takes the original in sight of the keeper. The broken seal raises suspicion; the facts survive.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: Hide the fragment
actions.result: A copy stays with the keeper. Kael conceals the original to protect the route out; the hidden removal damages trust if discovered.
actions.preview: A copy stays with the keeper. Kael conceals the original to protect the route out; the hidden removal damages trust if discovered.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

actions.label: Keep a signed copy. Leave the original where it can be read.
actions.result: Vale signs the copy. The original stays open under the lamp, and the command proof leaves with Kael.
actions.preview: Vale signs the copy. The original stays open under the lamp, and the command proof leaves with Kael.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

greyfen_cart_work.name: Rook

actions.label: Brace the wheel and help bring the driver inside.
actions.result: Kael lifts while Rook lays boards. The grain and its shaken driver reach Greyfen together.
actions.preview: Kael lifts while Rook lays boards. The grain and its shaken driver reach Greyfen together.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

greyfen_cart_work.greeting: The wheel has sunk to its hub. Rook braces the cart while the driver tries not to fall against it.
lines: Rook: If you are hunting something expensive, consider this wheel. It has eaten my entire morning.
Kael: Move your hand from the spoke. I will take the weight.
Rook: Then Anwen gets the driver, and the sacks get through the gate. In that order.

variants.greeting: The cart stands on dry boards. The driver has Anwen's cup between both hands.
lines: Rook: Grain inside. Person inside. A profitable morning by standards I have apparently lowered.

greyfen_road_work.name: Greyfen Road Work

actions.label: Lay clean boards and preserve the exposed fragments.
actions.result: The crossing is repaired. Refugee marks remain visible beside it instead of disappearing beneath new fill.
actions.preview: The crossing is repaired. Refugee marks remain visible beside it instead of disappearing beneath new fill.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

greyfen_road_work.greeting: Rain has opened the repaired strip where Bram found the old tokens.
lines: Tor: Put the clean boards over the rut. Leave the marked pieces where we can read them.
Kael: Repair the route without burying what it exposed.

variants.greeting: Clean boards span the rut. The marked fragments lie beside the warning post.
lines: Kael: People can pass here. The evidence has not gone back under their wheels.

edric_proclamation.name: Edric Proclamation

actions.label: Keep the renewal order with the road evidence.
actions.result: The current order joins the older command. Protection and assent have been deliberately made the same transaction.
actions.preview: The current order joins the older command. Protection and assent have been deliberately made the same transaction.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

edric_proclamation.greeting: By order of Lord Edric Vargan: grain protection is to be restored under a renewed road covenant.
lines: Each supported household must attend and witness the seal. Allotments will be entered beside its assent.
Kael: An order can move grain. It cannot make a hungry person's oath free.

variants.greeting: The household assent column has been struck from the order.
lines: Grain allotments remain. The account of the road is kept separately.

greyfen_relief_board.name: Greyfen Relief Board

actions.label: Arrange food, treatment, and a clear exit for the assembly.
actions.result: The relief list is kept separate from testimony. Food and a safe exit are offered whether a household speaks or refuses.
actions.preview: The relief list is kept separate from testimony. Food and a safe exit are offered whether a household speaks or refuses.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.

greyfen_relief_board.greeting: Anwen has left spaces for grain, medicine, clean iron, and a safe bed.
lines: Anwen: You may put your hand to one of those without agreeing to stand before the Hart.
Kael: Then keep the names of helpers away from the renewal seal.

variants.greeting: Grain sacks and clean cloth sit beside the assembly. The way out remains clear.
lines: Kael: Practical help before an oath. Nobody has to become evidence to receive it.

mill_distribution.name: Mill Distribution
mill_distribution.greeting: Clean reserve sacks stand apart from the mill's working channel.
lines: Mira: A short ration is a cost. So is using tainted machinery. The ledger does not make either disappear.
Kael: Keep the record whatever method gets the flour through.

variants.greeting: The tainted channel is closed. Reserve sacks are divided by household need.
lines: Mira: Clean repair takes time. For now, these sacks are what keeps the closure from becoming another barred gate.

variants.greeting: The limited run is watched. Contaminated stock is stacked separately.
lines: Mira: It gets flour through today. It does not settle what went into the channels or the work of replacing them.

variants.greeting: Clean repairs have begun. The first replacement sacks go to affected households.
lines: Kael: The accounts stay public. Repair is work that people can return to see.

renewal_record.name: Renewal Record
renewal_record.greeting: The old covenant hid a road. The proposed renewal would have hidden an account.
lines: The victims trusted a promise of sanctuary. The witnesses to concealment were frightened into agreement.
Kael: Copies prove the crime. A new promise must belong to the person who makes it. No ration list can lend somebody else's consent.

report_decision.name: Sister Anwen

actions.label: Give Anwen the token privately. Stay to protect those who speak.
actions.result: Anwen recognizes the older name and agrees to open the account. Kael stays to help protect its living witnesses.
actions.preview: Anwen recognizes the older name and agrees to open the account. Kael stays to help protect its living witnesses.
actions.cost: Public disclosure can expose witnesses; private or retained evidence delays the wider account.

actions.label: Make the evidence public. Stay to keep the witnesses safe.
actions.result: The token and wire are pinned beneath the contract. Some doors close; somebody brings dry cloth to cover the token. Kael remains responsible for the people newly visible.
actions.preview: The token and wire are pinned beneath the contract. Some doors close; somebody brings dry cloth to cover the token. Kael remains responsible for the people newly visible.
actions.cost: Public disclosure can expose witnesses; private or retained evidence delays the wider account.

actions.label: Keep the token. Make protected copies and stay with the investigation.
actions.result: Kael keeps the original and commits to copies. Anwen distrusts the delay, but he has promised to remain with the people who must carry the account.
actions.preview: Kael keeps the original and commits to copies. Anwen distrusts the delay, but he has promised to remain with the people who must carry the account.

report_decision.greeting: Anwen puts three empty cups beside the coat Oren left. Rook waits by the door.
lines: Kael: The creatures gathered their belongings. Someone alive bound the token afterward and tried to remove it.
Anwen: I recognize the old carving. You can give it to me, show the village, or keep it while we make copies.
Rook: If you show it, show the people behind it a way to stay safe as well.
Kael: I will stay. The payment ends the hunt. It does not settle what I now know.
